name: io.github.bartenderthiago82/weblens
title: WebLens
description: Web pages as clean data, plus RugProbe Base token safety checks. Pay per call in USDC (x402).

environmentVariables.name: WEBLENS_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key of a separate wallet holding a few dollars of USDC on Base; signs each payment locally

environmentVariables.name: WEBLENS_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Most the server may spend per session, in USD (default 1)
